Container.Name: pureamiga-crm-test
Container.Overview: Pure Amiga repairs CRM - TEST track (updates on every push to main, shows a TEST banner). Uses its own data folder, never the live one.
Container.ExtraParams: --restart unless-stopped --read-only --tmpfs /tmp --security-opt no-new-privileges:true --cap-drop ALL --cap-add CHOWN --cap-add DAC_OVERRIDE --cap-add FOWNER --cap-add SETUID --cap-add SETGID

Config.Name: Anthropic API key
Config.Description: Optional. Enables drafting the customer summary from the work log with Claude. Get one at console.anthropic.com
